title: Symrise invests in Bond Pet Foods to accelerate sustainable innovation in pet nutrition via precision fermentation
summary: ‒ Expands Symrise’s pet nutrition offering to meet rising demand for sustainable, responsible solutions ‒ Co-develops a new ingredient to support the shift toward sustainable options, including animal-identical protein, to diversify existing pet food portfolio ‒ Invests in Bond Pet Foods’ proprietary precision-fermentation platform to speed up commercialization of next-generation pet nutrition solutions

extraction.key_fact: 심라이즈는 정밀 발효 기술을 활용한 반려동물 영양 분야의 지속 가능한 혁신을 촉진하기 위해 본드 펫 푸즈에 투자했다.
